entries.name: Penguin
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets); stylized size: 0.7 m to the top of the crest, the standing height of a gentoo or Adelie penguin (an emperor stands ~1.1 m), so it sits between the library's fox (0.48 m) and pig (0.85 m) and comes up to about the cube-pet lion's (1.3 m) shoulder, the same near-real scale the lion uses, while the big cube head keeps it chibi; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 34). Same zip and Blender route as the elephant and lion, with Textures/colormap.png as an extra member and maxColors 64. Compared with the Quaternius Textured Cute Monster Pack penguin (OpenGameArt, CC0, Blends/Penguin.blend, ingested and rendered side by side): that one is a round head-only blob with no legs or feet and huge eyes, which reads as a monster more than a penguin; the Kenney cube pet stands upright on orange feet with flippers, a white front and a beak, so it reads as a penguin at a glance and ships. Look: the eyes are flat discs in the same dark grey as the body (they cannot be split by colour), so the body uses threshold 0.55 and faceted shading: the eye discs then always fall in the near-black shade and stay black through every clip, instead of flickering to navy when the head tilts up. All greys -> body, whites -> belly, oranges -> beak and feet.
